fixture_contract.coding: Pinned OpenBench task pack; external checker; three trials per candidate/task cell.
fixture_contract.speed: Same exact-answer and tool-turn probes; report TTFT, decode throughput, wall time, and provider usage.
fixture_contract.context: Same 16k, 64k, and long-prefix prompts; report fresh input, cache read, completion, and context-rotation correctness.
fixture_contract.long_running: Same multi-file project task, two fresh trials per candidate, hidden verifier, and clean process completion under a fixed wall budget. Score is mean hidden-checker score; timing remains in the separate speed dimension.
fixture_contract.tool_use: Same local browser fixture with an external verifier; tool errors, recovery, and artifact correctness are recorded.
fixture_contract.recovery: Interrupt at a controlled turn boundary, restart the same harness, resume the same task, and verify no duplicate or lost edits.

coverage_rule: A dimension is eligible only when every candidate has an equivalent runtime row. Missing rows remain missing and never become zero.
